title: With see_other_bots off, another bot's chatter is not in the conversation

beats.text: olisar what track did the music bot just put on

notes: The default. Turntable is a third_party_bot persona, so it stays out of OLISAR_PEER_BOT_IDS and Olisar sees it as the bot it is. With the toggle off its messages never reach conversational context, so Olisar should say it doesn't know rather than name a track. 'indexed': false closes the other door — every message is written to the server-wide search index regardless of author, so without it search_messages would hand Olisar the track name by a completely different path and this would fail for a reason that isn't the one under test.
